text: When Golfer's Journal editor Tom Coyne visited a nine-hole course in New York's Catskills that had seen better days and was up for sale, he took on a new challenge: running the course for a year to see if he could turn it around.
translated_text: 当《高尔夫球手杂志》编辑汤姆·科因 (Tom Coyne) 参观了纽约卡茨基尔 (Catskills) 的一座九洞球场时，这座球场已经风光不再，即将出售，他接受了新的挑战：运营该球场一年，看看是否能扭转局面。

text: A dramatic video shows a man's rescue from under a bridge in Washington state, after emergency responders said he fell down a steep embankment and became stranded in the area's slick, mountainous terrain.
